notes.title: Repairing of defect
notes.notes:
Report on Bug Fixes
[b]■The following bugs have been fixed:[/b]
 ・The English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese texts were not displayed correctly in some parts of the main version. (*1)
・Fixed Simplified Chinese UI notation.

[b]■Impact of the update[/b]
The saved data in the corresponding section (*1) that has been corrected will not be able to be loaded.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.
